title: ERP Bank Reconciliation Suite
shortDescription: A desktop and web bank reconciliation suite that matches bank statements to cashbook transactions and posts results into ERP.
businessProblem: Finance teams were reconciling bank statements against ERP cashbook transactions through a slow, error-prone manual process, with limited support for statement import, matching rules and controlled posting back into the ERP.
solution: Built a dual-platform bank reconciliation suite — a WinForms desktop application and a modern Blazor Server web application — that imports bank statements, supports manual and rule-based matching, creates related cashbook and AR transactions where needed, and posts reconciled results into Syspro ERP.
outcome: Gave finance teams a structured way to import statements, reconcile transactions and post results into ERP with an auditable history of matching and posting activity.
capabilities: Bank statement import with duplicate detection
Posting of reconciled results into ERP
Creation of cashbook and AR transactions from unmatched bank items

title: Dispatch Stock Label Printing
shortDescription: A workstation application that retrieves dispatch note stock lines from ERP and prints warehouse labels with preview and reprint support.
businessProblem: After dispatch processing, warehouse staff needed accurate stock labels printed from ERP dispatch note data. Manual label preparation was slow and reprinting previously printed labels was difficult.
solution: Developed a .NET WPF desktop application that integrates with Syspro via e.net WCF, retrieves dispatch note stock lines, allows per-line label quantities, provides print preview and supports both automatic launch after dispatch printing and manual reprinting.
outcome: Enabled warehouse teams to print and reprint dispatch-related stock labels directly from ERP data on local workstations, reducing reliance on manual label preparation.

title: ERP API Gateway & Production Reporting
shortDescription: A REST gateway and reporting dashboard that makes ERP business objects and production data accessible to modern applications and management users.
businessProblem: Modern applications and reporting tools struggled to consume ERP business objects exposed only through WCF/SOAP, while production and contract reporting required clearer visibility without relying on slow manual extracts.
solution: Built an ASP.NET Core gateway that translates REST/JSON requests into Syspro WCF business object calls and returns cleaned structured JSON. The same application includes a Blazor contracts and production reporting dashboard with Excel export, reading directly from ERP SQL databases where grid performance matters.
outcome: Provided a practical integration layer for ERP-connected applications and a management-facing view of contract and production cost information that can be exported for further analysis.
capabilities: REST to ERP business object bridge
Structured JSON responses from ERP queries

title: Supplier Banking Change Authorisation
shortDescription: An ERP workflow that captures supplier banking detail changes, records an audit trail and routes them for approval before they take effect.
businessProblem: Changes to supplier banking details needed stronger control. Without a formal authorisation path and audit trail, high-risk master data updates could be made without clear review or email notification.
solution: Implemented a Syspro-based supplier banking change workflow using ERP scripting and SQL audit tables. When banking details change, the system logs the old and new values, sets the change to pending and supports approval with email notification.
outcome: Introduced a controlled authorisation path for supplier banking updates, with a recorded audit history of requested changes and clearer operational oversight.
capabilities: SQL-based audit trail of changed fields

title: Controlled Warehouse Inventory Transfer
shortDescription: An ERP-assisted inventory transfer process that validates allowed warehouse routes before stock is moved between locations.
businessProblem: Inventory transfers between warehouses needed tighter control. Operators required clearer guidance on which destination warehouses were allowed for a given stock item and source warehouse, rather than relying on informal knowledge.
solution: Delivered a custom inventory transfer process integrated with ERP, using SQL-backed warehouse route rules to determine allowed transfer destinations and guide operators through controlled stock movement between warehouses.
outcome: Supported more controlled warehouse-to-warehouse transfers by enforcing configured routing rules instead of relying solely on manual knowledge of allowed movements.
